name: 3-Month Internship at Germany Trade & Invest
description:
Field/Department

Administrative

Location

New York City

The Company

Germany Trade & Invest (GTAI) is the economic development agency of the Federal Republic of Germany. Germany Trade and Invest - Gesellschaft für Außenwirtschaft und Standortmarketing mbH - was established on January 1, 2009 via a merger between Invest in Germany, the BfAI, and the GfAI. The organization promotes Germany as a business and technology location in addition to the recruitment of investors. Germany Trade & Invest provides up-to-date information and expert advice both to German companies seeking to expand their businesses abroad as well as to foreign companies looking to enter Germany.

The GTAI representative for the New York office is looking for an Economic Research intern (m/f) to support the field of "export and foreign markets" starting as soon as possible.

Responsibilities

Assist in attracting investors, in particular in:

  • Creating target group lists for conferences using an online marketing database
  • Implementing e-mail campaigns with the aim of finding (potential clients?) companies that want to do business in Germany
  • Conducting targeted market studies of German industries
  • Updating and creating PowerPoint presentations for potential investors
  • Conducting performance analyses of various industries in Germany
  • Composing weekly newsletters: news about companies planning to expand to Europe or Germany; news about selected industries
  • Analyzing selected companies using Hoovers (online database of companies) with the aim of presenting their investment potential in Germany and Europe

Administrative Tasks, which include:

  • General and administrative (e.g. cooperation with GACC administration, press subscription, etc.)
  • Maintaining contacts (such as associations, government agencies, research institutions, etc.)
  • Management and optimization of archives

Requirements

  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills, able to work independently and in a structured manner, quick understanding, logical thinking
  • Must be a current or continuing student or between undergrad and grad school with the intention of applying to and attending  grad school in the future
  • Fluent in English and German
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office, especially Excel
  • University degree in Economics or  Business Administration or equivalent is a plus

This is an unpaid internship; it can be used to receive credits at a university. GTAI is covering the J1 visa processing fee.

Expenses

International candidates pay the costs for health insurance, consular and SEVIS fees as well as travel expenses.

Did we spark your interest? We look forward to receiving your application. This position is available all year long. Please include in your application when you would be available.

name: Bookkeeping/Accounting Manager (Fulltime, Overtime-Exempt)
description:
About the Organization:

The German American Chamber of Commerce, Inc. (GACC) is a non-profit facilitator of business between Germany and the US. Founded in 1947, the organization’s mission is to support and establish economic ties between Germany and the United States.

Summary:

Build a secure and rewarding career within a reputable organization dedicated to long-term financial stability. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a team committed to upholding the highest standards of financial rigor and accountability. As our Bookkeeping/Accounting Manager, you will employ your problem-solving skills within a stable environment where precision and adherence to regulations are paramount.

Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  • Ensure excellent condition of the operation with hands-on management of day-to-day financial transactions, account reconciliations, invoicing, AP/AR, and collection of balances.
  • Perform monthly financial closing activities, procedures, journal entries and account reconciliations to ensure compliance with US GAAP.
  • Support the treasurer in internal and external audits, including preparation of required schedules and supplemental information. Responding to auditor inquiries.
  • Support the treasurer in preparation of annual tax returns for external tax consultants, including preparation of required schedules and supplemental information. Responding to tax advisor inquiries.
  • Prepare ad hoc financial reports as needed; assists in problem-solving.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritizing workflow to meet critical deadlines while paying exceptionally close attention to detail.
  • Work collaboratively with other departments to achieve shared goals.
  • Other duties as assigned

Competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business administration is required.
  • At least 2 years of experience in corporate accounting required.
  • Intermediate skill level in Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint required; knowledge of financial systems and enterprise software. QuickBooks Online and RAMP proficient is desired.
  • Knowledge of US GAAP is required.
  • Excellent critical thinking and analytical capabilities; strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain detailed records.
  • German language skills are a plus.
  • Knowledge of Sales and Use Tax collection and reporting is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.

Salary: $75,000 - $85,000 per year

If you are interested in this position, please apply with your resume and cover letter, including salary expectations.

Start date: Immediately

What we offer:

  • Comprehensive fringe benefits program including health insurance, 401(k) matching and paid vacation.

Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed, but they are not to be seen as a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Also, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the employer.

name: Industrial Executive Leadership Opportunity – Managing Director / Sales and Business Development
description:
Location: Midwest USA

Full-Time 

Onsite or Hybrid, depending on company location

As a trusted recruiting partner for a network of innovative German companies with operations in the United States, we are actively seeking to expand our pool of experienced executive-level candidates for upcoming and current leadership roles.

We are particularly interested in connecting with individuals who bring:

  • Proven P&L responsibility and leadership experience within small to mid-sized organizations (typically $10–50 million in revenue)
  • A solid track record in capital equipment or industrial technology environments
  • Deep experience in sales, business development, and cross-functional leadership (operations, finance, engineering, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of international business, ideally with exposure to European or German company structures and cultures
  • The ability to scale and optimize US subsidiaries of global companies while maintaining close collaboration with overseas headquarters

These roles typically involve steering the US entity’s growth strategy, enhancing market presence, leading cross-border collaboration, and ensuring operational excellence across all departments.

If you are an entrepreneurial leader who thrives in international settings and is passionate about shaping the future of a growing business, we would love to hear from you. By joining our candidate network, you’ll be considered for current and future openings with our German partner companies across the U.S.

Apply now to become part of our exclusive talent pool for high-impact executive roles in the German-American business landscape.

name: Technical Sales & Applications Manager - Advanced Composites
description:
Remote, United States | Midwest or Eastern U.S. preferred | 50–70% North American travel


Ready to take your composites expertise closer to the customer?

We're looking for someone who understands advanced composite materials and wants to play a bigger role in how those materials are applied, qualified, and ultimately commercialized.

Our client, an established international manufacturer of prepregs, advanced composites, and high-performance engineered materials, is expanding its North American composites business and is seeking a Technical Sales & Applications Manager – Advanced Composites.

You don't necessarily need to come from a traditional sales career. You might currently be an Applications Engineer, Composite Engineer, Technical Service Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or Technical Sales professional working with carbon fiber, fiberglass, thermoset composites, prepregs, or related structural composite technologies.

What matters is that you understand the materials, can work credibly with customers and engineers, and are interested in taking greater ownership of customer applications and commercial opportunities.

You'll work with OEMs, composite fabricators, processors, and distributors to understand technical requirements, identify applications, support material evaluation and qualification, and develop opportunities into long-term commercial business.

The company's advanced-composites portfolio includes thermoset prepregs and UD prepregs utilizing carbon, glass, aramid, basalt, and other reinforcement systems, along with laminates, reinforced materials, composite components, and specialized engineered-material solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Work directly with customers to understand material, processing, performance, and application requirements.
  • Identify and develop new customer and application opportunities for prepreg and advanced composite materials across North America.
  • Support material selection, sampling, testing, trials, qualification, specification, and commercialization.
  • Build relationships with OEMs, composite fabricators, processors, distributors, engineers, and technical decision-makers.
  • Translate customer challenges into technical and commercial opportunities in collaboration with engineering, product management, and manufacturing teams.
  • Develop new accounts and contribute to a qualified pipeline of customer and application opportunities.
  • Support technical presentations, quotations, proposals, pricing discussions, and commercial negotiations.
  • Coordinate customer projects with colleagues across North America and Europe.
  • Represent the company at customer meetings, industry events, and trade shows.

What You Bring

  • Professional experience with advanced composites, prepregs, carbon fiber, fiberglass, thermoset materials, or closely related structural composite technologies.
  • Practical understanding of composite materials and manufacturing processes such as layup, curing, molding, material testing, qualification, or composite fabrication.
  • Experience working directly with customers, suppliers, OEMs, fabricators, or other external technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand a customer's technical challenge and communicate effectively with both engineers and commercial decision-makers.
  • Interest in developing applications, customers, and new business in addition to providing technical support.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style and the ability to operate effectively within an international organization.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 50–70% throughout North America.

Experience with thermoset prepreg materials, resin systems, UD or fabric-reinforced prepregs, CFRP/GFRP, or prepreg processing is particularly valuable. Candidates with strong adjacent composite-material experience and the technical foundation to learn the company's specific prepreg portfolio are also encouraged to apply.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Target base salary: $110,000, commensurate with experience
  • Performance-based variable compensation
  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage
  • Company-supported dental and vision coverage
  • Employer-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance
  • Retirement savings participation with company match
  • 12–14 company-observed holidays annually
  • Progressive paid time-off structure that increases with tenure
  • Structured onboarding and technical product training

This is an opportunity to help build an advanced-composites business in North America while being backed by the technical expertise, manufacturing capabilities, and product portfolio of an established international organization.
